# PsychometRics

PsychometRics is an R package providing functions for psychometric
analysis. The package wraps several helper functions to offer efficient,
fast methods for common psychometric analyses.

## How it helps psychometric analysis

The package offers wrapper functions focused on Classical Test Theory
(CTT) and factor analysis (FA). These functions help identify
potentially weak items by producing diagnostic warnings. Interpret these
warnings and decisions to remove items carefully, as they require
subject-matter judgement.

## Install

``` r
install.packages("devtools")
library(devtools)
install_github("alsonicr/psychometRics")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`EFA.comp()`](EFA.comp.md) : EFA comparaison model
- [`EFA.explo()`](EFA.explo.md) : FA.exploratory
- [`NNT()`](NNT.md) : The number needed to treat (NNT)
- [`RI_crosslag_model()`](RI_crosslag_model.md) : The random intercept
  crosslag panel model
- [`SEM_cov()`](SEM_cov.md) : Title
- [`SEM_reg()`](SEM_reg.md) : SEM regression model
- [`SEM_reg_RI()`](SEM_reg_RI.md) : Regression Random Intercept
- [`SEM_wth_var()`](SEM_wth_var.md) : Title
- [`apa.n()`](apa.n.md) : APA formating number
- [`apa.p()`](apa.p.md) : APA formating number 2
- [`crosslag_model()`](crosslag_model.md) : Crosslag model formulat
- [`detecCTT-class`](detecCTT-class.md) : a summary function for
  detecCTT class
- [`detecRar-class`](detecRar-class.md) : a summary function for
  detecRar class
- [`detect.eval.ctt.warn()`](detect.eval.ctt.warn.md) : Classical test
  theory evaluation warning table
- [`detect.rar.warning()`](detect.rar.warning.md) : Correlation Answer
  Rest (RAR) warning table
- [`eval.ctt()`](eval.ctt.md) : Classical Test Theory Summary
- [`factor_explorer()`](factor_explorer.md) : Factor explorer
- [`print(`*`<EFA.comp>`*`)`](print.EFA.comp.md) : Print method for the
  rar class
- [`print(`*`<EFA.explo>`*`)`](print.EFA.explo.md) : Facto print method
- [`print(`*`<SEM>`*`)`](print.SEM.md) : Print method for SEM class
- [`print(`*`<alpha>`*`)`](print.alpha.md) : Print method for the alpha
  class
- [`print(`*`<detecCTT>`*`)`](print.detecCTT.md) : a print function for
  detecCTT class
- [`print(`*`<detecRar>`*`)`](print.detecRar.md) : a print function for
  deteRar class
- [`print(`*`<difficulty>`*`)`](print.difficulty.md) : Print method for
  the difficulty class
- [`print(`*`<discrimination>`*`)`](print.discrimination.md) : Print
  method for the difficulty class
- [`print(`*`<eval.ctt>`*`)`](print.eval.ctt.md) : Print Method for
  CTT_summary
- [`print(`*`<facto>`*`)`](print.facto.md) : Facto print method
- [`print(`*`<frequency>`*`)`](print.frequency.md) : Print method for
  the frequency class
- [`print(`*`<rar>`*`)`](print.rar.md) : Print method for the rar class
- [`scan.alpha()`](scan.alpha.md) : Cronbach alpha scan
- [`scan.diff()`](scan.diff.md) : Difficulty scan
- [`scan.disc()`](scan.disc.md) : Discrimination correlation
